sources.excerpt: Did you know that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible

reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye—let alone the only man-made structure visible—is a well-documented myth. Astronauts from NASA and China's space program (including Yang Liwei) have confirmed that the Great Wall cannot be distinguished from low Earth orbit without optical aid. Although it is very long, it is typically only 5 to 9 meters wide and constructed from local stones and soil that blend into the surrounding terrain, providing insufficient contrast and resolution for the human eye. In contrast, other man-made features (such as large highways, airports, canals, and city lights at night) can be seen with the unaided eye from low Earth orbit under favorable conditions.
